About this product

Micro Instruments MI-24DC48DC-POE is a 10/100/1000BASE-T Gigabit Ethernet PoE injector designed for South African networks. It converts 12V or 24V DC input power into 48V DC output for PoE devices. The unit supports up to 30W total power delivery across multiple ports. It ensures reliable connectivity for IP cameras, access points, and other PoE equipment without requiring external power cables at the device end.
